The season began on 3 April and is scheduled to end in December 2026.{{cite web |last=Siles |first=Ramiro |url=https://premiumsportsbo.com/clubes-aprueban-un-torneo-amistoso-para-iniciar-la-temporada/ |title=Clubes aprueban un torneo amistoso para iniciar la temporada |trans-title=Clubs approve a friendly tournament to begin the season |publisher=Premium |language=es |date=12 January 2026 |access-date=15 January 2026}}{{cite web |last=Suárez Vargas |first=Martín |url=https://www.reduno.com.bo/deportes/atencion-hinchas-conozcan-el-fixture-del-futbol-boliviano-2026-2026330123931 |title=¡Atención, hinchas! Conozcan el fixture del fútbol boliviano 2026 |trans-title=Attention, fans! Get to know the 2026 fixture of Bolivian football |publisher=[[Red Uno de Bolivia]] |language=es |date=30 March 2026 |access-date=31 March 2026}} [[Club Always Ready|Always Ready]] are the defending champions. On 10 June 2026, the tournament was suspended by the [[Bolivian Football Federation]] due to the [[2026 Bolivian protests]], which disrupted the scheduling of previous matchdays.{{cite web |last=Asturizaga Quisbert |first=Jorge |url=https://diez.bo/futbol/la-fbf-paraliza-el-todos-contra-todos-hasta-nuevo-aviso_1781140386 |title=Bolivia paraliza el campeonato profesional por las protestas y bloqueos de carreteras |trans-title=Bolivia halts the professional championship due to the protests and road blockades |publisher=[[El Deber|Diez]] |language=es |date=10 June 2026 |access-date=17 June 2026}}{{cite web |last=Siles |first=Ramiro |url=https://premiumsportsbo.com/inicio-tardio-y-encima-suspensiones-la-liga-se-complica/ |title=Inicio tardío y encima suspensiones: la Liga se complica |trans-title=Late start and suspensions on top of that: the League gets complicated |publisher=Premium |language=es |date=24 May 2026 |access-date=17 June 2026}} The competition resumed on 7 July.{{cite web |last=Rivero de Ugarte |first=Pedro |url=https://diez.bo/futbol/la-fbf-confirmo-el-regreso-del-futbol-profesional-para-el-7-de-julio_1782397223 |title=La FBF confirmó el regreso del fútbol profesional para el 7 de julio |trans-title=FBF confirmed the return of professional football for 7 July |publisher=[[El Deber|Diez]] |language=es |date=25 June 2026 |access-date=28 June 2026}} ==Format== The format for the season was first discussed at a meeting of the División Profesional's Council held on 12 January 2026, in which the clubs voted to keep the double round-robin format for the tournament (30 matchdays), starting from the first weekend of April. The competition format was ultimately confirmed on 23 March 2026, when it was also announced that qualification for the 2027 edition of the [[Copa Libertadores]] will be awarded to the top three teams at the end of the season, with the league champions and runners-up entering the group stage, whilst the next best three teams will qualify for the [[Copa Sudamericana]]. The team placing last at the end of the season will be relegated, with the team placing second-from-last playing the promotion/relegation play-off series against the Copa Simón Bolívar runners-up.{{cite web |url=https://www.atb.com.bo/2026/03/23/la-division-profesional-define-su-temporada-2026-con-dos-torneos/ |title=La División Profesional define su temporada 2026 con dos torneos |trans-title=The División Profesional sets its 2026 season with two tournaments |publisher=[[Red ATB]] |language=es |date=23 March 2026 |access-date=26 March 2026}} ==Teams== Sixteen teams compete in the league for the 2026 season, those being the top 14 teams from [[2025 FBF División Profesional|the previous season]], along with the 2025 [[Copa Simón Bolívar (Bolivia)|Copa Simón Bolívar]] champions [[Club Real Potosí|Real Potosí]] and the winners of the [[2025 FBF División Profesional#Promotion/relegation play-off|promotion/relegation play-off]] [[Academia del Balompié Boliviano|ABB]], who also competed in the 2025 División Profesional. Having competed in the top flight for the last time in [[2021 Bolivian Primera División|2021]], Real Potosí achieved promotion on 7 December 2025 by defeating [[Integración del Norte San Juan F.C.|San Juan]] and winning the Copa Simón Bolívar title.{{cite web |url=https://eldeber.com.bo/deportes/real-potosi-conquista-copa-simon-bolivar-retorna-primera-cuatro-anos-despues_1765134738 |title=Real Potosí conquista la Copa Simón Bolívar y retorna a primera cuatro años después |trans-title=Real Potosí win the Copa Simón Bolívar and return to the top flight four years later |publisher=[[El Deber]] |language=es |date=7 December 2025 |access-date=19 December 2025}} They replaced [[C.D.
